name: The Crusade
description: Religious war — manage faith and steel simultaneously. Clergy demand zeal, generals demand supply.
victory: Hold Jerusalem analogue 12 turns or convert 2 rivals
defeat: Faith collapse or army routed in winter
gemini_theme: Crusader letters, papal bulls, desert sermons

name: The Plague
description: 30-turn survival scenario. Population hemorrhages, trade collapses, physicians versus priests.
gemini_theme: Physician journals, street elegies, quarantine edicts

name: The Succession Crisis
description: Heir is a child. Regency council rules — nobles test every edict.
victory: Heir reaches 16 and is crowned with loyalty >0.5
defeat: Regent usurps or civil war fires

name: The Mongol Tide
description: Defend against a massively superior horde. Fortify, evacuate, or submit.
victory: Repel 3 waves or endure until horde fractures
gemini_theme: Horde drums, envoy ultimatums, smoke columns

name: The Renaissance
description: Culture and knowledge victory only. Patronage, not conquest, wins laurels.
defeat: War declared on you stalls patronage 6 turns
gemini_theme: Atelier gossip, humanist letters, fresco unveilings

name: The Merchant Republic
description: Economy-only. No military conquest allowed. Corner markets, buy rivals out.
gemini_theme: Bourse chatter, ledger drama, cartel whispers

name: The Great Schism
description: Clergy schism fractures faith. Pick orthodoxy, reform, or cynical balance — streets will answer.
victory: Resolve schism with happiness >0.6 and no revolt 12 turns
defeat: Clergy revolt or capital schism riot
gemini_theme: Synod debates, heretic sermons, crowd psalms

name: Custom Scenario
description: AI generates a unique scenario from your prompt. Your words become the timeline.
special_rules: Falls back to 'Fertile Lands' if no key
prompt_placeholder: e.g., 'A comet cult, a salt famine, and a child prophet…'
